items.title: Is It Actually Gold?

question.text: The gold you see is paint.

choices.response: Look again. This one uses metal leaf.
Yes. Gold leaf, not yellow paint.

items.reveal: It is real gold leaf on the upper floors.
items.notes: Confirm which floors are leafed before live.

items.title: Find the Bird
items.task: Find the bird on the roof. Do not look at a photo first.
items.reveal: A phoenix. Check the exact meaning before we print it.
items.notes: Confirm the roof bird as a phoenix (hō-ō) and its usual symbolism before live.

items.title: The Temple That Burned
story: The pavilion you see is not the first.
In 1950 a young monk set it on fire.
What you walk around was rebuilt.
items.reveal: Rebuilt in 1955. The gold is later care, not untouched medieval skin.
items.notes: Keep the arson story short. No sensational detail.

items.title: Build Paradise

question.text: If you built a paradise here, what would you start with?

items.task: Find which of those pieces the garden actually uses.
